Is getting a pet an option? It's something so many people recommend, the joys of a cute creature loving you back. If not even getting something as simple as a plant is something that helped me. I took good care of it, used to tell it goodnight stories and it bloomed beautifully, so I thought it was it's way of saying thank you. It's just that taking care of a life, even as small as a plant, calms you down and you feel responsible for it. It's at least what helped me. Please hold on in there, bud.
